subject.title: Dashboard: ops widgets — agent status + approvals queue

question: Should the approvals builtin be accepted as a custom-widget approval queue only, or must it expose the existing exec/plugin approval queues before the linked operator problem is considered solved?
rationale: The branch deliberately avoids the operator-scoped approval RPCs, so implementation quality alone cannot decide whether its narrower behavior matches the intended product and security boundary.

options.title: Require operator approvals
options.body: Keep the broader approval issue open and require a security-reviewed dashboard API for listing and resolving exec and plugin approvals.

options.title: Scope to widget approvals
options.body: Rename and document the builtin as a custom-widget approvals queue and stop claiming it delivers the exec-approval dashboard request.

options.title: Split agent status first
options.body: Land the agent-status widget separately and defer the approvals widget until its permanent scope is approved.

recommendation.title: Require operator approvals
recommendation.body: Keep the broader approval issue open and require a security-reviewed dashboard API for listing and resolving exec and plugin approvals.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent history shows ownership across the bundled Control UI lifecycle, session refresh behavior, and adjacent gateway approval contracts, making this the strongest available routing candidate for the cross-surface decision.
